segments.vo: Ranking the ten most powerful Spider-Men ever. Number one can rewrite reality.

segments.name: KAINE PARKER
segments.vo: Ten. Kaine, the Scarlet Spider. Peter's clone, with a brutal healing factor.

segments.name: SILK
segments.vo: Nine. Silk. Same spider bite as Peter, but an even stronger spider-sense.

segments.name: MILES MORALES
segments.vo: Eight. Miles Morales. Venom blasts. Invisibility. Only number eight? Fight me in the comments.

segments.name: SPIDER-MAN 2099
segments.vo: Seven. Spider-Man twenty ninety-nine. Talons, fangs, and a genius from the future.

segments.name: SUPERIOR SPIDER-MAN
segments.vo: Six. The Superior Spider-Man. Doc Ock in Peter's body, with his own army.

segments.name: SPIDERS-MAN
segments.vo: Five. Spiders-Man. He wasn't bitten by a spider. He is spiders.
But the top four? Whole different level.

segments.name: BEYONDER SPIDER-MAN
segments.vo: Four. Beyonder Spider-Man. Near-omnipotent. Creates and destroys entire realities.

segments.name: ZOMBIE SPIDER-MAN
segments.vo: Three. Zombie Spider-Man. He ate the Power Cosmic, and he's still hungry.

segments.name: SPIDER-HULK
segments.vo: Two. Spider-Hulk. Spider-sense, plus Hulk rage. Good luck.

segments.name: COSMIC SPIDER-MAN
segments.vo: And number one. Cosmic Spider-Man. Peter Parker, with the power of the entire universe.
Who's your number one? Comment below, and follow for part two.
